closure_rule: A production-live loop is closed only when sense -> interpret -> constrain -> act -> adapt all fire on live owner-surface data, every transition emits a receipt to that owner surface, and a fresh agent can replay an automated check. Scratch or self-seeded bounded replays are HARNESS_PROVEN, not CLOSED_LIVE.

provider_truth.definition: Counts rows carrying actual served provider/model truth. A2A runtime_receipts are canonical even when receipt_json is empty.

verdict_tiers.CLOSED_LIVE: The loop is proven from its declared live owner surface, with no scratch-only or self-seeded evidence standing in for production state.
verdict_tiers.HARNESS_PROVEN: A bounded replay/regression harness proves the loop can execute sense -> interpret -> constrain -> act -> adapt, but the evidence may be scratch or manufactured by the harness and is not production-live closure.
